description: Canonical puzzle/solution catalog plus solver retrieval, fragment indexes and replay-backed glyph evidence for Opus Magnum Codex.

identity.canonicalStructuralHash: translation/rotation invariant hash preserving program timing
identity.canonicalMechanismHash: translation/rotation invariant hash with normalized program timing
identity.puzzleFeatureFingerprint: hash of solver-relevant puzzle chemistry, molecule topology, available parts and production constraints

limitations: Bonder and unbonder geometry uses the two occupied glyph hexes and still requires OMSim corpus cross-validation.
Calcification converts air, earth, fire and water on its anchor cell to salt.
Multibonder, prismatic bonding and all other conversion glyphs are not yet simulated.
Collision validation is not yet simulated.

fragmentIndex.purpose: Catalog reusable local functional sub-mechanisms extracted from historical solutions.

evidenceLevels.dynamic-confirmed: Replay directly observed the functional effect at the fragment anchor, including supported glyph mutations.
evidenceLevels.dynamic-arm-observed: Replay observed arm activity inside the fragment, but the anchor effect was not simulated or observed.
evidenceLevels.structural-only: Fragment is inferred from geometry only or no matching puzzle replay was available.
